tools.label: Change files anywhere in the workspace, every project

ideas.name: Weekly health check-in
ideas.prompt: Compare this week's sleep, steps and workouts with last week's, and tell me one thing to change.

ideas.name: Morning brief
ideas.prompt: Look at today's calendar and the top tech headlines, then give me a five-line brief with anything I should prepare for.

ideas.name: Tomorrow at a glance
ideas.prompt: Look at tomorrow's calendar and tell me, in three lines, when my day starts, what needs preparing tonight, and any gap for a break.

ideas.name: News on a topic
ideas.prompt: Find the three most important news stories from the last day on my topic, each in one line with its source. My topic is:

ideas.name: Weekly summary of a project
ideas.prompt: Read this project's files and summarize what it does and what changed recently, in a short list.

ideas.name: Check a site is up
ideas.prompt: Open my website and tell me whether it loads and anything that looks broken. My website is:

ideas.name: Weekly storage check
ideas.prompt: Check what is using my phone's storage and report where things stand. Name the five biggest wins and any duplicates, with sizes, and propose what to delete. Do not delete anything: list the files and I will decide.
